chain.dataOwner: User and appointed ERP business-process owners
chain.externalSideEffectBoundary: Local source, test, Harness files and CI configuration only; no production changes, deployment, migrations, external messages, secrets or push.
chain.parentOutcome: Establish a fail-closed, risk-oriented ERP quality-control system that maps business invariants to test sizes and layers, protects critical user journeys, proves Postgres/migration/concurrency correctness, blocks regressions in CI, stores fresh Harness evidence and reports actionable operational outcomes.
chain.checkoutWorktreePolicy: Current checkout is dirty. One writer at a time in the primary checkout; read-only exploration may share it. Unrelated submodule and report changes stay outside this chain.
chain.rejectedLowerRungs: Do nothing cannot deliver executable gates and fresh failure evidence; existing pytest, Vitest, CI and Harness tools must be reused before adding machinery.
chain.nextMinimalSliceAcceptance: G05: prove ERP Medium-layer money/stock/RBAC correctness with real Postgres, migrations, idempotency and concurrency evidence.
chain.userVisibleScenario: A broken assertion, coverage drop, test deletion, unclassified test, lint-warning increase, flaky retry or readiness/background failure produces a failed CI/Harness gate naming the suite, module, artifact and next action; a passing change produces a fresh acceptance report tied to the current commit.

testOperatingModel.small: No database, network or filesystem I/O; pure unit rules and isolated handlers.
testOperatingModel.medium: Local API/integration boundaries with explicit database/service contracts.
testOperatingModel.large: Real service composition and browser only for critical user journeys and recovery paths.
testOperatingModel.policy: No fixed test-count ratio; use risk coverage, freshness, isolation, flake rate, invariant detection and escaped-defect evidence.
testOperatingModel.retryPolicy: No automatic retries for Small/Medium; at most one diagnostic retry for Large/E2E, always reported as flaky evidence.
testOperatingModel.releaseRule: Unit green is not sale-ready; required Postgres, migration, CUJ, alerting and rollback evidence must also pass.

chain.modelRouting: gpt-5.6-luna / max for all test-writing, test-count, CI-gate and implementation slices; gpt-6-astra / xhigh for the independent final correctness and safety review; no silent substitution.

subgoals.observableResult: Plan revision 4 approval and executable passport state are validated before the first evidence run.
subgoals.acceptance: User approval provenance, bounded continuation authority, revision equality and validator-readable state are recorded; no product acceptance is implied.

subgoals.observableResult: Gate-truth baseline: current lint/test failures, markers, counts, coverage and infrastructure assumptions.
subgoals.acceptance: Fresh collection, unit/full backend, frontend coverage/typecheck/lint, Ruff, commit and infrastructure evidence are recorded; red product gates remain explicit and no-green is claimed.

subgoals.observableResult: ERP risk/invariant catalog and CUJ matrix.
subgoals.acceptance: Finance, stock, RBAC, accounting, integrations and data lifecycle have owners, severity, expected invariant and required test layers.

subgoals.observableResult: Machine-readable inventory by backend/frontend, Small/Medium/Large size, layer, domain, CUJ and unclassified state.
subgoals.acceptance: Native collectors produce counts, JUnit/JSON evidence, retry/skip/xfail data and a durable deletion/regression baseline.

subgoals.observableResult: Separate CI gates, deterministic installs and one required aggregator.
subgoals.acceptance: Registry integrity and negative-case evidence are fresh; CI uses npm ci, explicit unit/api/integration marker lanes, merge_group and a fail-closed quality-required aggregator; the integration JUnit report rejects all-skipped or zero-executed results; retries are diagnostic-only with bounded quarantine; remote CI remains unrun.

subgoals.observableResult: ERP Medium-layer correctness: Postgres, migrations, contracts, idempotency and concurrency.
subgoals.acceptance: Real Postgres and migration evidence cover money/stock/RBAC invariants; SQLite E2E is not used as a substitute.

subgoals.observableResult: High-signal readiness, runtime-alert and flake controls.
subgoals.acceptance: `/ready`, structured incidents and diagnostic-only retry/flake policy are covered by 19 executed local tests; live webhook/production alert configuration remains an explicit release blocker and is not claimed.

subgoals.observableResult: Full regression and release report with defect/exception decisions.
subgoals.acceptance: Full results, CUJ matrix, migration/rollback evidence, P0/P1 blockers, branch-protection checklist and next actions are recorded honestly.

subgoals.observableResult: Project-owned Harness evidence, metrics and operational scorecard.
subgoals.acceptance: Acceptance, fingerprint, test counts, defects, schema-2 metrics and DORA fields are fresh and tied to one commit.
Independent reproduction passes; unnecessary files/gates are removed; parent acceptance is fresh; no production claim is inferred.
